Game Overview

Greedy Freedy is a animal title where guide Freedy, the hungry squirrel, through retro pixel landscapes, collecting chestnuts while dodging obstacles. Experience increasing speed and difficulty, relying on timing and precision to master each level. This arcade delight blends nostalgia with a challenging twist, promising an engaging and addictive gaming adventure.
